job: Jump to a page or run an action by typing, from anywhere.
purpose: A modal search palette on Cmd+K or Ctrl+K. A search field over grouped, fuzzy-matched items with the matched letters lit. Items come from markup or from command.register(). Focus stays in the field; the active row is announced through aria-activedescendant.
useWhen: An app has many pages and actions and power users want the keyboard.
People should reach a recent run, a doc or a setting without navigating.
Actions need shortcuts and hints shown beside them.

avoidWhen.when: Searching one list on one page.
Choosing a value in a form.
A short list of actions on one trigger.
Site-wide navigation that must always be visible.

states.name: open
states.how: data-state="open" on the dialog; also command.open()

states.name: empty
states.how: fd-command-empty is shown when nothing matches

variants.useWhen: A leading icon on an item.

parts.role: A muted hint or shortcut at the end.

keyboard.does: Opens and closes the first palette on the page.
Moves the active row; Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P also work.
